courseName: [CENG 111 ALL Secitons] Introduction to Computer Eng. Concepts
title: sample_quiz
description:
Middle East Technical University Department of Computer Engineering
CENG 111
Introduction to Computer Engineering Concepts
Linux Quiz
Name : ID :
Instructions
For each question, run the commands required to accomplish the listed tasks in order. You may need
to type more than one command for some of the questions.
You can check your grade by running the script named “grade” under the “ceng111quiz” folder.
This script takes a single argument, your user id (e1XXXXXX). For instance, if your student id is
“e1234567”, you will run the script as: ./grade e1234567.
When the quiz finishes your grades will be collected automatically. Change your current directory
to “ceng111quiz” and start typing. For all the questions, assume that your current directory is
“ceng111quiz”; i.e., paths are relative to “ceng111quiz”.
IMPORTANT: Please write your name and student ID at the top and return this paper to your
lab assistant at the end of the quiz; otherwise, you will get a zero!
Question-1 (4 points each)
1. Create a new folder named “ceng111”.
2. Create a new file named “hw1.py” under “ceng111” folder.
3. Remove the folder named “data”.
4. Copy the file named “issue” placed under the “/etc” folder to the folder named “ceng111”.
5. Copy the folder named “ceng111” placed under the “courses” folder to the “ceng111” folder
with the name “111”.
6. Change the name of the file “hello.c” to “hw2.c”.
7. Move the file named “syllabus.txt” under “courses/math120” folder to the “courses/math119”
folder.
8. Append a line to the file named “hello.txt”. The line to be appended is “ignorance is bliss”
without the quotes.
1
-- 1 of 2 --
Question-2 (5 points each)
1. Change the permission of the file “hw1.sh” under “forbidden” folder so that the owner can read,
write and execute but others (g and o) can only execute.
2. Copy the file named “cant.touch.this” under “forbidden” folder to “courses/ceng100” folder.
3. Execute the script named “tryme.sh” under “forbidden” folder.
4. Copy the folder named “recycle” under “forbidden” folder to “courses/ceng100” folder.
Question-3 (5 points each)
1. List the names of the files/folders that are located under the “courses” folder and direct the
output to a file named “courses.txt” under the current directory.
2. Count the number of files/folders that are located under the “courses/ceng230/” folder and
write the result to a file named “num230.txt” under the current directory.
3. Copy the lines that contain the word “java” from the file “courses/ceng443/hw1.txt” to the file
“hw1.java.txt” under the current directory.
4. Find all the files, under the “courses” folder and its subfolders recursively, that contain the word
“hw1” in their names and append the output to a file named “cengs.txt” under the current
directory. Important: You should run this/these command/s under the “ceng111quiz” folder.
Otherwise, the output would be different than we expect. Hint: “find”.
5. Copy the words placed in the file named “courses/ceng140/words.txt” to a file named
“courses/ceng140/dict.txt” sorted alphabetically. Hint: “sort” (Do NOT use it with -d option.)
Question-4 (5 points each)
